channel.title: Tampa Bay News Monitor
channel.description: Press releases and breaking news, Tampa Bay

item.title: [BREAKING] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] ICE officer charged with lying in Minneapolis shooting investigation
item.description: Federal prosecutors charged an ICE officer with lying about a Minneapolis shooting after video evidence contradicted initial claims during an immigration crackdown.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Bipartisan lawmakers call on Rubio to address Iran's executions and arrests
item.description: A group of lawmakers is urging Secretary of State Marco Rubio to take stronger actions against what they describe as an escalating campaign of executions and political repression by Iran's government.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Hillary Clinton, Jill Biden and others honor Gloria Steinem, who has died at 92
item.description: Former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton, former first lady Jill Biden and a slew of writers and social justice activists are lauding Gloria Steinem as a revolutionary and inspiring figure.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Nvidia to spend billions on Hugging Face, the startup that was hacked by OpenAI
item.description: Chipmaker Nvidia is buying artificial intelligence software platform Hugging Face for $13 billion. It's the latest deal by the company, whose processors are integral to the AI boom.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] New video series aims to reduce veteran suicide and mental health stigma
item.description: The APA Foundation launched a video series to address veteran suicide, featuring real stories from veterans and families to reduce mental health stigma.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] St. Pete man hit, killed by 4 cars while walking on I-275: FHP
item.description: A St. Petersburg man walking on Interstate 275 in Pinellas County was killed Wednesday night after being hit by four vehicles, troopers said.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Pete Hegseth faces calls to resign as troop deployments in extended to 2027
item.description: Sen. Thom Tillis is calling on Trump to fire Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth amid reports of troop deployment extensions into 2027.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Sarasota judge cited after leaving the scene of a two-car crash
item.description: A Sarasota judge accused of sideswiping another vehicle was cited for careless driving and failure to give information after leaving the scene of an accident. According to a police report, Circuit Judge Thomas Krugg told investigators he did not realize he struck the car while attempting to merge into its lane.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Grady Judd: 2 of Lakeland’s top 5 drug dealers arrested in 'Operation End of Worlds'
item.description: A wiretap investigation shattered a massive drug trafficking ring operating out of Lakeland, resulting in 39 arrests and the seizure of enough fentanyl to kill a million people, Polk County Sheriff Grady Judd announced Thursday.
